title: skyblock
description: Optimized Hypixel SkyBlock client modpack with QoL, HUD and performance mods
body: A lightweight Hypixel SkyBlock client modpack designed to improve gameplay with quality-of-life features, overlays and performance enhancements. Includes SkyHanni, Skyblocker, SkyblockAddons Unofficial, REI and other helpful tools. The pack focuses on better UI, faster information access and smoother performance while remaining fully Hypixel-compatible.
